summary: AMC Entertainment Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 95,250,000 shares of common stock at $2.10 per share, targeting $200 million gross proceeds. Roth Capital Partners acts as exclusive placement agent on a best-efforts basis, receiving 5.5% cash fee. The stock is NYSE-listed under AMC, with recent price volatility noted. Shares close on June 24, 2026. This is capital-raising, not a special-situation event.
